output:
lifecycle-demo
NAMES            STATUS
lifecycle-demo   Up Less than a second

observation: Processes resume exactly where they stopped.

output:
lifecycle-demo
NAMES            STATUS

title: Stop (graceful, SIGTERM then SIGKILL)
observation: State: Exited. Docker sends SIGTERM, waits, then SIGKILL; the filesystem is kept.

command: docker restart lifecycle-demo && docker ps --filter name=lifecycle-demo --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
output:
lifecycle-demo
NAMES            STATUS

observation: Stop followed by start; the container returns to Running.

observation: Forces immediate termination, exit code 137 (128 + 9).
